title: Positive bribery bound
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, with $2\le n$. Suppose $\delta>0$ and $\delta$ is at most the variance of the real-valued sign representation of $f$. Let $0<\varepsilon<1/2$. Then there is a set $J$ of coordinates such that setting every coordinate in $J$ to $+1$ gives a function with mean at least $1-\varepsilon$, and $|J|\le 1+\frac{100n}{\log n}\log\!\left(\frac{8}{\varepsilon\delta}\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$\delta$ is at most the variance of the real-valued sign representation of $f$
